This filter started leaking under my refrigerator within a week of installing it. Ruined the hardwood floor under the fridge, because I did not see it leaking underneath for several days, judging by the damage.

I tried to go cheap, but now will have to replace that section of hardwood. Don't be like me! Spend the extra $20 on the real #9915 filter, not this almost-fits-but-not-quite garbage.

Good replacement part for the same Kenmore filter and the value twin pack is a benefit.  You have to realize that the coupling link is slightly different for the whirlpool version to the Kenmore version. It locks in place with only a 3/4 turn and the handle does not fully turn to a straight horizontal position, but is fully seated.  So, do not continue to turn the handle trying to have it rest in a full horizontal position.  It is locked in place with the handle slightly slanted.  I have been monitoring for any leaks now for over a month and no problems.  Would recommend.

Purchased this product about 6 months ago for my Whirlpool (it normally used to take Whirlpool Pur filter #4396701), and had no problems with this generic replacement. When the indicator light recently went off, I did not hesitate to order another one. I did see the negative reviews about it breaking under the fridge and ruining people's floors and wondered about that... Upon receiving my newest one, I totally understand why. At first I couldn't get the filter to go in correctly and decided to put the two side by side. They both said they were the same model (RWF1021), but they were not the same. The newer one is longer and the way it screws in is not the same. I took a picture and will try to attach it to this review -- The one on the right is the newer one. You can see by the plastic tip it won't screw in the same and it is longer. Also, the newer one looks like it could easily leak from the nozzle to where it attaches to the tube part. It is not "sealed" -- or doesn't look fully sealed like my other one. I am totally disgusted. What a waste.
3/18/16 UPDATE: DiscountFilterStore promptly contacted me and were concerned about my negative experience. They kindly refunded me the cost of the filter (extra star added for their good customer service) - Unfortunately, I do think people who are looking for a replacement filter for 4396701 need to know that the filter they receive may not be the best fit for their refrigerator.
